faq.question: Can the ratio be changed?

faq.question: Why would a buyer choose the blend over separate kits?
faq.answer: The blend removes a handling step and guarantees a fixed ratio in every vial, which suits comparative protocols. Buyers who need independent concentration control should order the components separately.
